pairs.evidence: app/_lib/db/core.ts:168 core.ts owns the single decode seam: absent and unreadable are separate answers, and every corrupt or invalid column is counted in getRowHealth() before the value is returned. Around it sit atomic table rebuilds, bound-parameter seed marks and real-engine tests on an isolated store, and none of the techniques checked here is breached.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/db/core.ts:168 One seam returns absent/ok/unreadable and records corrupt and invalid columns in a counted ledger (getRowHealth), so a skip can never be silent. The safeRowParse back-compat wrapper still feeds the same ledger.

app/_lib/db/core.ts:103 The validator is typed structurally so core never imports zod or the generated schemas. Its other imports are leaf or domain modules (tenancy, workspace-lock, pipeline-stages types).

app/_lib/db/core.ts:2870 PK-widening rebuilds drop any orphaned scratch table and run inside db.transaction, so a killed boot rolls back whole instead of wedging. seedDemoCorpus runs under .immediate().
app/_lib/db/seed-marks.ts:20 Values are bound. The interpolated identifiers in migrations come from closed literal lists (for example the created_at/stage_changed_at ALTER loop).
app/_lib/db/core.ts:3400 Seed and import writes take a row array and run inside one transaction instead of one write per caller loop.

app/_lib/db/core-migrations.test.ts:10 Tests run against real SQLite on a throwaway file per process, built through ensureDb() (the production migration road). row-health.test.ts drills corrupt and invalid columns and asserts the counter, not just the result.
app/_lib/db/pg-portability.ts:9 Only SQLite exists. pg-portability is a dialect audit for a future port, and a postgres backend fails fast in db-path, so no second driver sits behind the surface.
app/_lib/db/core.ts:321 The schema is fixed DDL in code. No operator-authored record types are materialized at runtime.

pairs.evidence: app/_lib/db/pipeline-core.ts:66 The pipeline store declares its row shape and mapper twice (PipelineRow and rowToEntry in both pipeline.ts and pipeline-core.ts), and the same goes for the event-sort allowlist and the listPipelineEvents family (pipeline.ts and pipeline-events.ts). A field or column added to one copy can silently round-trip as its default through the other, even though the transactions and CAS guards are exemplary.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:492 Unknown approval_kind text passes through as a union member by cast, which is the banned silent third option. The mapper also exists twice (pipeline-core.ts:66 is a twin), and parseGithubEvidence parses JSON directly, logging but bypassing the counted readRowColumn ledger.

app/_lib/db/pipeline-core.ts:160 Values are bound and ORDER BY goes through an allowlist, but the allowlist and the IN-clause builder (eventKindClause) are each defined twice (pipeline.ts:206/226 and pipeline-core.ts:140/160). The vocabulary has no single authority.

app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:3727 Read→compute→write runs under .immediate() with expectedStage/expectedApprovalKind CAS. Cross-store work (dev_outcomes, interview revoke) and the stage hook run after commit.
app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:3085 Set-shaped read, chunked IN-query (SQL_IN_CHUNK) returning a keyed map, so callers holding many ids don't loop the singular read.

app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:32 Stage arrival correctly uses an injected hook registry (stage-hook-registry). Recording deletion (fs plus decision-config-store), dev-outcomes and dev-control (which imports auth/session) are direct upward imports rather than hooks.

app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:2920 Erasure scrubs and stamps the DB row (the authority readers gate on) inside the transaction, and unlinks the audio files only after commit. A failed unlink is logged and later caught by the retention sweep.
app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:167 The board payload is an explicit allowlist projection (BOARD_ENTRY_FIELDS), so a new column reaches the browser only on purpose.
app/_lib/db/pipeline-store.test.ts:8 Real SQLite on an isolated per-process store, with fixtures created through createPipelineEntry/actOnPipelineEntry (the front door).
